title: Chocolate Tart
desc: Patinated scratched steel reflects a low streak of directional window light in a minimalist industrial studio space. At center stage rests a refined dark chocolate tartlet on hand-shaped dark ceramic, its glossy ganache shell punctuated by coarse Maldon salt crystals while a velvety carved groove reveals the dense, indulgent interior.
businessBrief: Rich morning ambiance with organic steam and velvety syrup drizzles, crafted for high-end brunch editorial and hospitality marketing.
